changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.6.6:

• 🎙️ Smart Wake Detection: Robust multi-word phrase filtering ('Hey Jarvis', 'Hello Jarvis', 'Hi Jarvis') preventing accidental triggers from singing, background audio, or casual speech.

• 🔄 Clean Standby Recovery: Cleared session cache upon standby entry to eliminate stale turn replays.

• ⚡ Zero-Delay Mic Capture: Instant hardware microphone acquisition with pre-connection buffering so no spoken words are lost during connection.

• 🎨 Seamless Theme Switching: Dynamic UI color and theme updates without restarting the activity or interrupting active AI conversations.

• 🗣️ Instant Voice Reconfiguration: Voice model and persona updates apply dynamically without needing a service restart.
